findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "delete" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read · Private data: read, write, delete · Public sink: write, delete · Destructive: delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read · Private data: read, write, delete · Public sink: write, delete · Destructive: delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
